title: Explain every test flow in a client rollout
method: Synthetic 100-flow acceptance test. Categories are disjoint and sum to 100. Unexpected bypass is a configuration finding in this hypothetical test, not a product benchmark or a claim of security effectiveness.
alt: Explain every test flow in a client rollout. Intended managed path: 85 flows; Documented exclusions: 10 flows; Unexpected bypass: 5 flows. Illustrative values.
